description.zh:
需要绑定的输入媒体Bucket名称，不超过64个字节。可以通过**MPS控制台**>**工作流管理**>**媒体Bucket**获取。

> Bucket名称只允许小写字母、数字、中划线（-），且不能以中划线开头或结尾。
description.en:
The name of the input media bucket to be bound. The name can be up to 64 bytes in size. To obtain the media bucket name, you can log on to the **ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console** and choose **Workflows** > **Media Buckets** in the left-side navigation pane.

> The bucket name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and cannot start or end with a hyphen (-).

description.zh:
OSS防盗链设置。更多信息请参见[防盗链](~~31869~~)。

> - MPS设置的防盗链不会对OSS文件防盗链生效。若OSS没有设置防盗链，则MPS也无需设置。   
   > - 此处添加的Referer须为OSS侧防盗链中包含的Referer。如果您在OSS侧设置了多个Referer，MPS侧只需设置一个即可。
description.en: The settings of Object Storage Service (OSS) hotlink protection. For more information, see [Hotlink protection](~~31869~~).

descriptions.zh:
在使用本接口进行绑定之前，您需要先创建媒体Bucket。如果没有创建媒体Bucket，请先参见[添加媒体Bucket](~~42430~~)添加完成后，再调用本接口进行绑定。

##  QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation to bind an input media bucket, you must create a media bucket. For more information, see [Add media buckets](~~42430~~).

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts bind-input-bucket --bucket example-bucket-0000 --referer http://www.example.com --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
